Week 9

Move from basic ARIMA to seasonal ARIMA and compare ARIMA forecasts against ETS alternatives.

Prepare before class

Read Sections 9.8 to 9.10 of FPP3 and focus on how seasonal ARIMA extends the earlier material.

Seminar and workshop

Wednesday 06 May · Seminar 3:00pm to 3:50pm, workshop 4:00pm to 4:50pm · Building K Level 3, K321

Focus
  • Seasonal ARIMA structure
  • Generating and interpreting ARIMA forecasts
  • Comparing ARIMA and ETS
Assessment

GA3 on Tuesday 05 May · Week 9 quiz on Wednesday 06 May

## What you will learn this week * Seasonal ARIMA models * Computing forecasts for ARIMA models * ARIMA vs ETS models ## Pre-class activities Read [Sections 9.8-9.10 of the textbook](https://otexts.com/fpp3/arima.html) and watch all embedded videos ## Tutorial exercises ::: {.callout-note} ## Tutorial Learning Objectives 1. **Develop and evaluate seasonal ARIMA models**. - Able to transform/difference seasonal series, fit and diagnose competing ARIMA models, and produce forecasts (including comparing against ETS and STL-adjusted approaches). 2. **Compute ARIMA-based forecasts manually**. - Able to use a specified ARIMA model equation and estimated parameters to hand-calculate multi-step forecasts, then fit the same model in R and explain differences between manual and software forecasts. ::: - Complete Exercises 11, 12, 13, 15 (d,e), 16 (d,e) from [Section 9.11 of the book](https://otexts.com/fpp3/arima-exercises.html). ## Assignments * [GA3](../assignments/G3.qmd) is due on Tuesday 05 May. * [IA4](../assignments/A4.qmd) is due on Friday 15 May. ## Weekly quiz * Week 9 quiz: [ETF3231](https://learning.monash.edu/mod/quiz/view.php?id=5400155) | [ETF5231](https://learning.monash.edu/mod/quiz/view.php?id=5402242) — Due Wednesday 06 May.
